% 18.10.2023  [Through Hybrid Mode]
1.

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no.0056/2012 registered under section 498A IPC at P.S. Mehrauli along with consequential proceedings.

2. The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 got married on 02.04.1995 according to Hindu Rites and Customs at Arya Samaj Mandir and out of their marriage two children, namely, Baljinder Singh and Manpreet Singh were born who at present are under the care and custody of the petitioner.
The petitioner and the respondent no.2 due to matrimonial differences, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 23:50:36 started to live separately w.e.f. 07.11.2009 without any cohabitation.
3. The respondent no.2 got registered present FIR bearing no.0056/2012 registered under section 498A IPC at P.S. Mehrauli, wherein the petitioner was implicated.

The respondent no.2 appeared Sh. Jatender Singh @ Jitender Singh vs State & Anr on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95309319/
1 through video call.

sentences.text: The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer, SI Jyoti Joshi, P.S. Mehrauli as well as by their respective counsel.
After completion of investigation, the charge-sheet was filed and the trial is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Sana Khan, MM (Mahila Court), District South, Saket Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: MM (Mahila Court), District South, Saket Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. The petitioner and the respondent no.2 have settled their disputes and have agreed to dissolve their marriage by decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act,
1955.

The marriage between the petitioner and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved vide judgment dated 13.04.2015 in divorce petition bearing HMA no.282/2015 titled as Jitender Singh and Anita Kaur passed by the concerned Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, South, Saket Courts, New Delhi.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, South, Saket Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. The respective counsel for the petitioner and the respondent no.2 stated that as the petitioner and the respondent no.2 have settled their disputes amicably.

The marriage between the petitioner and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved vide judgment dated 13.04.2015, as such the present petition be allowed and the FIR bearing no. 0056/2012 along with consequential proceedings be quashed.

6. The respondent no.2 stated that she has settled all pending disputes with the petitioner out of her own free will and without any force, fear and coercion and such she does not have any objection if the present petition is This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 23:50:36 allowed and FIR bearing no. 0056/2012 along with consequential proceedings is quashed.

7. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no.1/State also stated that as the petitioner and the respondent no.2 have already settled their disputes amicably, as such he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0056/2012 registered under section 498A IPC at P.S. Mehrauli along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings is quashed.
8. The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 got married on 02.04.1995 and due to matrimonial differences, they are living separately since 07.11.2009 without any cohabitation.
The petitioner and the respondent no.2 have already settled their pending disputes amicably.
The marriage between the petitioner and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved as detailed hereinabove.

No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no. 0056/2012 are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.
9.

After considering all facts and in the interest of justice, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0056/2012 registered under section 498A IPC at P.S. Mehrauli along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending in the Court of Ms. Sana Khan, MM (Mahila Court), District South, Saket Courts, Delhi/Successor Court is quashed.
